# Commerce upgrade: implementation evidence and release decision

All customer/order examples below are isolated TEST ONLY fixtures. This report contains no real receipt, customer record, private artwork or secure document capability. Production is unchanged.

## 1. Venmo / external receipts

**VERIFIED:** the old required-only note field disagreed with the server's five-character minimum; raw Zod text reached the screen. Request ids were regenerated by the form and discarded by the server. Studio documents and provider invoices are separate obligations. Invoice creation claims and pending checkouts also require reconciliation; the screenshots do not establish order #4's ledger state.

**IMPLEMENTED:** shared field validation; explicit Venmo/cash/bank/Zelle/other method; local date/time conversion; integer cents; saving lock; retry-stable request recovery; transactional receipt/reference checks; private actor/method/time/reference/note audit; ledger-derived paid/remaining confirmation; explicit provider-confirmed eligible Stripe checkout expiry and existing unpaid invoice void workflow. Manual receipts never counterfeit processor events. Proof remains independent.

**VERIFIED:** six receipt integration tests; partial/full and concurrent retry coverage; invalid/future/excess amounts, roles, invoice claims and checkout conflicts. Phone-sized browser validation and refresh recovery are in `screenshots/manual-payment/` locally.

**NEEDS VERIFICATION:** live order #4, the genuine Venmo receipt, current provider obligations and current production role. No production DB/provider credentials or authenticated browser access were available. Follow the private owner confirmation steps in [COMMERCE_UPGRADE_RELEASE.md](COMMERCE_UPGRADE_RELEASE.md); never add a second receipt without inspecting history.

## 2. Owner workspace and Customer 360

**IMPLEMENTED:** grouped navigation; active attention counts linked to payment/proof/readiness filters; distinct financial/artwork/production states; next safe action; prominent financial summary; private original and versioned production files; linked Studio/order timeline; readable errors across owner editors. An unpaid order can no longer be marked Ready for production.

**VERIFIED:** before/after desktop and 390-pixel screenshots, no horizontal overflow or browser exceptions: `screenshots/owner-workspace/{before,after}/`. Seven task/readiness tests separate all-time history from active tasks and enforce both gates. Existing delegated staff redactions and server permissions remain in force.

**IMPLEMENTED:** persistent UUID/customer-number profiles independent of checkout; real optional email and normalized phone with explicit country context; name/phone/email/customer/order search; duplicate review, reviewed linking, archive/restore, notes/preferences and record export. Historical per-order profiles are not silently merged by shared email. Public accounts cannot claim a profile by typing contact details; reviewed associations require a verified existing account and staff-administration permission.

**IMPLEMENTED:** multiple private designs/revisions, exact model/colorway ids, nominal inches, material/shape, text, normalized placement, quantity and notes; immutable original bytes/checksum/MIME/dimensions/provenance; separate safe raster previews; direct private uploads and original-order-art capture. New phone drafts copy genuine source bytes, calculate current published prices/availability and freeze current photo/calibration. New proof approval is required. Genuine email is required only for existing document/provider paths that need it; phone-only profiles/drafts do not invent email or create public logins.

**VERIFIED:** nine CRM/migration tests include populated historical backfill, original-byte checks, multiple immutable revisions, unavailable/retired product rejection, price/inventory changes, role/customer isolation, explicit account association, source ownership and reviewed linking. The 25-unit fixture prepares/issues the existing separate Studio invoice and proof, rotates the proof link, records one test external receipt, rejects production before approval and advances after current approval. A new process reopens disk-backed test storage and verifies original SHA-256, exact variant, revisions and payment records. Browser logout/new-context/relogin and a separate server restart preserve the same business records. Local screenshots: `screenshots/customer-vault/`.

**NEEDS VERIFICATION:** production-like Neon concurrency and migration rehearsal; physical iPhone/native SMS composition; identity review for actual historical contacts. Universal inline customer creation inside every old quote/invoice editor and customer-facing vault editing are not claimed. Customers and Orders expose the working profile/phone-order entry points; the phone-order-to-existing-document path is connected.

## 3. Hat studio

**VERIFIED:** [exact-photo coverage](HAT_PHOTO_COVERAGE.csv) and [audit](HAT_PHOTO_AUDIT.md): 235 active front photographs; 222 retained high-resolution originals; 13 detail-limited sources (seven 112FPR, six 168P). Eight historical 112PM photo entries are excluded from active coverage and new delivery derivatives. No static physical references are measured; production-published owner geometry was unavailable for inspection.

**IMPLEMENTED:** source-bound responsive WebP derivatives; painted CSS width × density × zoom selection; unchanged canonical photo coordinates and calibration identity; missing/wrong-dimension fallback to the identical original; honest detail-limited and failed-view states; no percentage-sized patch overlays on uncalibrated side/rear photos. The independent photo entrance transform was removed so photo and overlay do not animate apart. Current front previews use nominal inches through one physical projection; historical snapshots and legacy coordinate conversion remain intact.

**IMPLEMENTED:** normalized pointer/touch and keyboard placement, Center/Reset, Undo, hideable guides, automatic-fit explanation, explicit physical size choices, placement presets below the photograph, mobile model grid and exact-color search. Exact local front-photo thumbnails also replace fragile remote requests where retained photography exists. Die-cut artwork shows its nominal bounding area with a cutline-review indication, rather than inventing a finished contour or stitching. Owner calibration tests multiple shapes/sizes and displays exact-model source/measurement coverage using existing draft/publish/revert controls.

**VERIFIED:** six-model real-image benchmark at desktop 2× and phone 3×; 27 real-photo model/size frames and 108 responsive frames across nine active models, including 320px and landscape; ten interaction/failure/reload behaviors. CSS geometry tolerance is 0.75px; actual delivery-change geometry difference was 0px. Intentional network-failure cases produce expected console resource failures and no page exceptions. Thirty-eight geometry tests include a synthetic measured crop fixture with numerical tolerance below 1e-8; that fixture is arithmetic evidence, not a measurement of a real hat.

| Verified 112 sample | Original delivery | New delivery | Required native width | Byte reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Phone 390px, density 3 | 3000px / 430,560 bytes | 1200px / 113,392 bytes | 1170px | 74% |
| Desktop 1440px, density 2 | 3000px / 430,560 bytes | 1800px / 190,388 bytes | 1728px | 56% |

Delivery derivatives are generated from retained exact sources during the build, validated by SHA-256/decoded dimensions/framing and excluded from Git as reproducible output. Source originals and derivative provenance remain retained. No source is upscaled, fabricated, replaced with another model or altered for production.

**NEEDS VERIFICATION:** actual physical dimensions for each photographed crown, replacement source photography for the 13 limited-detail entries, real-device rendering and owner acceptance of attachment/material fidelity. A stable rendering test does not prove millimeter accuracy or a universal photorealistic result. Remote Drive side/rear delivery depends on the genuine source service; failures show an explicit unavailable state.

## 4. Product-led improvements and existing capability audit

| Opportunity | Baseline classification | Feature-branch result |
|---|---|---|
| Private media, genuine gallery, consent, crop/rotation, publish/revert | EXISTING | Extended exact color/material/shape/size links; original customer art excluded; availability/pricing checked; unavailable examples direct to a quote |
| Artwork intake | NEEDS FIX | Selected-size pixel/background diagnostics, safe SVG rejection, original-byte preservation, server-generated order intake metadata and internal review alert; proof still authoritative |
| Bulk/team quotes, secure estimate acceptance, Studio invoice/proof | EXISTING | Homepage entry added; 25-unit inquiry reaches owner queue; 25-unit phone draft reuses current pricing and existing documents/ledger |
| Production board, order operations | EXISTING / NEEDS FIX | Reconciled attention filters and actionable states; unpaid Ready for production closed; payment/proof holds remain independent |
| Owner-created phone-only profiles and reusable private design originals | MISSING | Persistent shared customer/order identity, versioned vault and prefilled current-price repeat drafts implemented and tested |
| Public “staging builder” and source-file language | NEEDS FIX | Replaced on homepage with factual photographed-material/proof wording; no new services or policy promises |
| Pricing/promotion, stock import, document branding, content/policy draft and publish/revert | EXISTING | Reused and regression-tested; no parallel systems |
| Customer self-service vault, resumable large guest uploads, profitability/cost assumptions, advanced consented marketing | PROPOSED | Explicit follow-on backlog; no invented metrics, discounts, account claims, costs or communications |

**VERIFIED:** iPhone-width owner photo publication → public gallery → exact builder prefill → original artwork upload → unsafe SVG rejection → reload preserving original → keyboard/Undo/guides. A second public path homepage → 25-unit request → owner quote queue succeeds. The publication test uses a clearly labelled authentic catalog-reference TEST fixture, not an invented completed client job. Real finished-work publication still requires the owner's accurate configuration and rights confirmation. Screenshots: `screenshots/commerce-growth/` locally.

Evidence-ranked customer friction at baseline: (1) model-only gallery links required reselecting the exact color/material/shape/size; (2) artwork warnings ignored chosen physical size and opaque backgrounds; (3) 13 exact-photo sources lacked enough pixels; (4) side/rear overlays used arbitrary percentages; (5) group quoting lacked a primary homepage path and public copy exposed staging/source-file language. Browser evidence covers the modified flows; no claim is made of a controlled human conversion study or measured reduction in every tap count.

## 5. Regression and safety

**VERIFIED:** P0 [PR #10](https://github.com/robbystauss-rgb/blaze-berry-gem-pilot/pull/10) passed both CI jobs, including disposable PostgreSQL, at head b6a86c223b87bd4b74b949f1f100b93f49b5749a. Vercel returned zero deployments. The wider PostgreSQL CRM rehearsal has separate CI coverage and remains pending until its PR runs.

**VERIFIED locally:** default regression suites (234 + 55 tests), commerce 50, providers 20, Studio 19, external receipts 6, customer vault/backfill 9, operations 44, catalog retirement/media 17, intake 4, photo selection 6, geometry 38; counts overlap across script groups and are not a unique-test total. Typecheck and build pass. Lint has no errors; existing warnings are tracked in local logs. Browser fixtures use no real provider credentials, send no real email/text and perform no production writes.

**IMPLEMENTED:** additive migrations `0018_manual_payment_receipts.sql` and `0019_customer_design_vault.sql`; populated historical migration regression; immutable receipts/art/revisions/history; development-only durable-test-storage hook that refuses production/Vercel; build asset provenance gates; PR CI coverage and an opt-in disposable PostgreSQL rehearsal expanded to profile/art/draft/receipt concurrency.

**NEEDS VERIFICATION:** actual PostgreSQL CI result (the opt-in test is skipped locally without a disposable PostgreSQL target), Neon staging, field LCP/CLS/INP, physical assistive-technology and native-device testing. Local density/viewport/keyboard tests are not a WCAG certification or field Core Web Vitals measurement. Private customer originals, test session credentials and secure links remain outside tracked evidence.

## 6. Release readiness

**NO-GO for production.** The feature branch is reviewable; it is not merged or live. The exact feature branch has automatic Vercel Git deployment disabled. Existing cron/customer communication settings are unchanged. See [release and rollback requirements](COMMERCE_UPGRADE_RELEASE.md).

Approval must name the exact commits, isolated staging database/migration rehearsal and provider sandbox verification before any production rollout. P0 can be released independently from draft PR #10 after its own approval; it must not wait for optional growth work. Before production migration obtain a secure backup and tested restore, rehearse 0018/0019 on an isolated copy, inspect historical profile backfill and rehearse compensating recovery. Do not drop ledger/vault data or restore NOT NULL email over phone-only drafts. The old application is not a safe rollback for those new drafts; disable affected operations or retain the compatible app.

Small owner decision/evidence queue: genuine receipt/current obligations for order #4; known physical references and sharper exact 112FPR/168P photos; consent and exact choices for real completed-work examples; any future policy, new product process, margin assumptions or paid messaging service. No new recurring vendor cost or business offering was introduced.
